Script.name: SR Gauges (library)
Script.script:
-- Shattered Realms: HP / Mana / Enemy bars along the bottom of the window. -- No moves bar: the server intentionally never sends moves. SR = SR or {} SR.state = SR.state or { hp = 0, mana = 0, maxhp = 1, maxmana = 1, enemy = "", enemypct = 0 } SR.BAR_H = 22 SR.BAR_PAD = 3
function SR.gaugeY() local _, h = getMainWindowSize() return h - SR.BAR_H - SR.BAR_PAD end
function SR.buildGauges() if SR.hpGauge then return end setBorderBottom(SR.BAR_H + 2 * SR.BAR_PAD) local y = SR.gaugeY() local function make(name, x, r, g, b) local gg = Geyser.Gauge:new({ name = name, x = x, y = y, width = "33%", height = SR.BAR_H, }) gg.front:setColor(r, g, b) gg.back:setColor(math.floor(r / 4), math.floor(g / 4), math.floor(b / 4)) gg:setValue(0, 1, "") return gg end SR.hpGauge = make("SR_hpGauge", "0%", 200, 30, 30) SR.manaGauge = make("SR_manaGauge", "33%", 40, 80, 220) SR.enemyGauge = make("SR_enemyGauge", "66%", 200, 120, 20) SR.enemyGauge:hide() end
function SR.layoutGauges() if not SR.hpGauge then return end local y = SR.gaugeY() SR.hpGauge:move(nil, y) SR.manaGauge:move(nil, y) SR.enemyGauge:move(nil, y) end
function SR.redrawGauges() SR.buildGauges() local s = SR.state local maxhp = math.max(s.maxhp, 1) local maxmana = math.max(s.maxmana, 1) SR.hpGauge:setValue(math.min(s.hp, maxhp), maxhp, string.format("HP %d / %d", s.hp, s.maxhp)) SR.manaGauge:setValue(math.min(s.mana, maxmana), maxmana, string.format("Mana %d / %d", s.mana, s.maxmana)) if s.enemy == nil or s.enemy == "" then SR.enemyGauge:hide() else SR.enemyGauge:show() SR.enemyGauge:setValue(math.max(0, math.min(s.enemypct, 100)), 100, string.format("%s %d%%", s.enemy, s.enemypct)) end end
function SR.onVitals() local v = gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.vitals if not v then return end SR.state.hp = tonumber(v.hp) or SR.state.hp SR.state.mana = tonumber(v.mana) or SR.state.mana SR.redrawGauges() end
function SR.onMaxStats() local m = gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.maxstats if not m then return end SR.state.maxhp = tonumber(m.maxhp) or SR.state.maxhp SR.state.maxmana = tonumber(m.maxmana) or SR.state.maxmana SR.redrawGauges() end
function SR.onStatus() local c = gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.status if not c then return end SR.state.enemy = c.enemy or "" SR.state.enemypct = tonumber(c.enemypct) or 0 SR.redrawGauges() end
if SR.resizeHandler then killAnonymousEventHandler(SR.resizeHandler) end SR.resizeHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysWindowResizeEvent", SR.layoutGauges)
-- Draw straight away from data that arrived before this package loaded -- (installing mid-session): the game only resends vitals when they change. SR.onMaxStats() SR.onVitals() SR.onStatus()

Script.name: SR Mapper (library)
Script.script:
-- Shattered Realms: automatic map from gmcp.room.info. -- The room number the game sends is used directly as the Mudlet room id. -- (It is a stable per-room id, not the game's internal room number.) SR = SR or {} SR.map = SR.map or { last = nil, exits = {}, pending = {} }
-- Map info box: Mudlet's built-in one shows the room id number. Swap it for -- one that shows only the room and area names. Needs Mudlet 4.11+; on older -- versions pcall skips this and the default box stays. pcall(function() registerMapInfo("Shattered Realms", function(roomId, selectionSize, areaId) if not roomId or roomId == -1 or not roomExists(roomId) then return "" end local area = areaId and getRoomAreaName(areaId) if type(area) ~= "string" then area = "" end return string.format("Room: %s\nArea: %s", getRoomName(roomId) or "", area) end) disableMapInfo("Short") disableMapInfo("Full") enableMapInfo("Shattered Realms") end)
SR.DIRS = { n = { name = "north", dx = 0, dy = 1, dz = 0 }, s = { name = "south", dx = 0, dy = -1, dz = 0 }, e = { name = "east", dx = 1, dy = 0, dz = 0 }, w = { name = "west", dx = -1, dy = 0, dz = 0 }, u = { name = "up", dx = 0, dy = 0, dz = 1 }, d = { name = "down", dx = 0, dy = 0, dz = -1 }, }
function SR.areaFor(zone) if zone == nil or zone == "" then zone = "Unknown" end local t = getAreaTable() or {} if not t[zone] then addAreaName(zone) t = getAreaTable() or {} end return t[zone] end
-- Which direction leads from room 'from' to room 'to', per the exits we saw there. function SR.dirTo(from, to) local ex = SR.map.exits[from] if not ex then return nil end for d, target in pairs(ex) do if target == to and SR.DIRS[d] then return d end end return nil end
function SR.linkExit(from, dirKey, target) setExit(from, target, SR.DIRS[dirKey].name) end
function SR.onRoom() local r = gmcp and gmcp.room and gmcp.room.info if not r or r.num == nil then return end local num = tonumber(r.num) -- -1 means the character cannot see: keep the old position, draw nothing. if not num or num < 0 then return end local exits = r.exits or {} local prev = SR.map.last local areaId = SR.areaFor(r.zone)
if not roomExists(num) then addRoom(num) local x, y, z = 0, 0, 0 local guessed = false if prev and roomExists(prev) then local px, py, pz = getRoomCoordinates(prev) local dir = SR.dirTo(prev, num) if dir then local o = SR.DIRS[dir] x, y, z = px + o.dx, py + o.dy, pz + o.dz else -- Arrived some other way (portal, recall, ...): park it beside the -- previous room and flag it so the player can see it is a guess. x, y, z = px + 3, py, pz guessed = true end end setRoomArea(num, areaId) setRoomCoordinates(num, x, y, z) if guessed then setRoomChar(num, "?") end -- Rooms that already pointed at this one can now be linked. local waiting = SR.map.pending[num] if waiting then for _, p in ipairs(waiting) do if roomExists(p.from) then SR.linkExit(p.from, p.dir, num) end end SR.map.pending[num] = nil end end
setRoomName(num, r.name or "") setRoomUserData(num, "terrain", r.terrain or "") setRoomUserData(num, "zone", r.zone or "")
for d, target in pairs(exits) do if SR.DIRS[d] and type(target) == "number" then if roomExists(target) then SR.linkExit(num, d, target) else setRoomUserData(num, "pending_" .. d, tostring(target)) local list = SR.map.pending[target] or {} SR.map.pending[target] = list local dup = false for _, p in ipairs(list) do if p.from == num and p.dir == d then dup = true end end if not dup then table.insert(list, { from = num, dir = d }) end end end end
SR.map.exits[num] = exits SR.map.last = num centerview(num) end
-- Register the GMCP event handlers. This script loads after the gauges script, -- so SR.onVitals / SR.onMaxStats / SR.onStatus / SR.onRoom are all defined here. SR.handlerIds = SR.handlerIds or {} local function reg(event, fn) if SR.handlerIds[event] then killAnonymousEventHandler(SR.handlerIds[event]) end SR.handlerIds[event] = registerAnonymousEventHandler(event, fn) end reg("gmcp.char.vitals", SR.onVitals) reg("gmcp.char.maxstats", SR.onMaxStats) reg("gmcp.char.status", SR.onStatus) reg("gmcp.room.info", SR.onRoom)
